title: Reorganize examples folder: testing-only spec suite (no duplication)
description: The AnthusAI/Tactus-examples project now holds education/tutorial examples. The `examples/` folder in this repo is no longer for education—it should serve only as a testing/spec suite. Reorganize to avoid duplication and retain only the examples needed for a good spec suite that covers everything.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria: Audit all .tac files in examples/; identify overlap with Tactus-examples and internal duplication; remove or consolidate redundant examples; retain a minimal set that gives full spec coverage (basics, features, eval, models, MCP, file I/O, tools, mocking, HITL, BDD, etc.); document which examples are kept and why (e.g. in examples/README.md).
custom.beads_close_reason: Examples folder is curated spec suite with manifest and coverage README; duplication handled
custom.beads_notes: Renumbered curated examples to close gaps; manifest and docs updated to new numbering; test harness and feature table adjusted; archive checkpoint docs corrected. test_all_examples passes (98 run, 62 skipped expected).
